name: io.github.subodhkc/llmverify-mcp
title: LLMVerify MCP
description: Local-first MCP server exposing the llmverify AI output verification engine — heuristic hallucination-risk signals, prompt-injection detection, PII check/redaction, JSON validation, and audit receipts over stdio. Results are risk indicators for triage, not factual verification or compliance certification.

environmentVariables.name: LLMVERIFY_MCP_MAX_INPUT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Max characters accepted in a content/input argument

environmentVariables.name: LLMVERIFY_MCP_MAX_OUTPUT_ITEMS
environmentVariables.description: Cap on any single output array

environmentVariables.name: LLMVERIFY_MCP_MAX_TEXT_FIELD_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Cap on any single text field in output

environmentVariables.name: LLMVERIFY_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Base directory for engine local state

environmentVariables.name: LLMVERIFY_AUDIT_HASH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Enables keyed hmac-sha256 content hashes in audit records

environmentVariables.name: LLMVERIFY_AUDIT_NO_CONTENT_HASH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable content hashes in audit records
